blurb: Slider with multiple draggable thumbs for setting many values along one track.
description: A slider supporting 3+ thumbs, each independently draggable, for complex multi-value selection.
use_when: Setting multiple values along a continuum (e.g., multiple waypoints).
avoid_when: Simple single or dual range cases.
a11y: Keyboard navigation between multiple thumbs may not be clear. Test thoroughly.
